name: Defector
firstNightReminder: Wake the Defector and show them a Minion's token.
ability: You start knowing an in-play Minion. You are safe from Minions.
flavor: I know you. There was blood, and masks, and blades raised. And now you've followed me into the void.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon uses their Boffin ability on you, it malfunctions.
If the Defector nominates the protected player, the Devil's Advocate is poisoned until dusk.
If the Defector nominates & executes the good twin, nothing happens.
If the Defector nominates the Goblin the Goblin is poisoned until dusk.
If the Scarlet Woman has become the Demon, you are safe from them.
You register as a not-in-play good character to the Spy.
The Summoner can choose that the Defector player is the new Demon.
You register as a not-in-play good character to the Widow.
